name: Ultramarine & Pigments Ltd
tagline: Small-cap pigments/surfactants maker with a multi-year, trusted-tracked capex-driven capacity ramp and a real recent growth acceleration -- facing new competitive risk
business_overview: Ultramarine & Pigments manufactures ultramarine blue/violet pigments and surfactants, with an ongoing multi-year capex program (pigments capacity raised toward 7,200 MT, surfactant subsidiary expansions) and a minor wind-power side business.
fundamentals_table: Consolidated revenue Rs 774.77 Cr (+12%; standalone Rs 706.97 Cr +9%); net profit Rs 80.77 Cr
Consolidated net profit Rs 31.6 Cr (+~56% YoY); revenue Rs 239.96 Cr (~Rs 960 Cr annualised)
Net cash - borrowings Rs 86 Cr vs investments Rs 376 Cr (~30% of market cap); FY26 CFO Rs 128 Cr, FCF Rs 62 Cr; dividend Rs 6/share
Naidupeta pigment expansion completed FY26; new Rs 250 Cr Tamil Nadu greenfield (2,500 MT) phased FY27-29
fundamentals_narrative: ROCE/ROE (~11% / ~9% FY26) stay below this project's quality bar - partly because a large Rs 376 Cr investment book earns below operating returns - but earnings are now inflecting: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT rose ~56% YoY to Rs 31.6 Cr on the completed Naidupeta capacity, after FY26 consolidated revenue grew 12% to Rs 774.77 Cr. The balance sheet is net cash, cash generation is solid (FY26 CFO Rs 128 Cr, FCF Rs 62 Cr), dividends are consistent, and the stock trades at ~13.6x earnings / ~1.4x book. A fresh Rs 250 Cr Tamil Nadu greenfield (FY27-29) is a large commitment against a Rs 81 Cr PAT base and will weigh on ROCE near-term, and Sudarshan's post-Heubach competition remains an unresolved threat to pigment realisations.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 20 of 176 posts (single batch, spanning May 2023-Nov 2025, no escalation needed). harsh.beria93 (trusted) has tracked the company's capex program in detail across two updates (Jul 2023, Jun 2025), most recently confirming a pigments capacity increase from 6,000 to 7,200 MT (85% utilization) as of the FY25 update. A 2024 dip in EPS drew mixed reaction -- one poster called it a buying opportunity given continued capacity expansion, another attributed it mainly to cost inflation, not demand weakness. A real competitive risk emerged Oct 2024: Sudarshan Chemicals' acquisition of Heubach was flagged as likely to increase pigments competition as Sudarshan fills capacity to drive operating leverage.
community_signal: harsh.beria93 (trusted, elevated) is the thread's most consistent tracker, with detailed capex-timeline updates in Jul 2023 and Jun 2025 (8 loves) confirming the capacity-expansion thesis is on track as of the most recent update.

trusted_signals.note: Updated FY25 capex: pigments capacity raised from 6,000 to 7,200 MT (Q2FY25 announcement), operating at 85% utilization.

verdict_headline: A trusted-confirmed capacity-driven growth acceleration (Q1 FY27 PAT +56%) with a net-cash balance sheet and a cheap ~14x multiple - but structurally weak profitability (ROCE ~11%) and the Sudarshan/Heubach competitive threat cap it at Low-Medium
verdict_reasoning: The revenue/PAT acceleration is corroborated by a trusted, multi-year tracker's capex-timeline updates (harsh.beria93, elevated), which is exactly the recent-inflection evidence this project weights: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT +56% YoY to Rs 32 Cr, TTM revenue Rs 830 Cr vs FY26 Rs 775 Cr, Naidupeta pigment expansion completed.

four_box score 2.5 (tailwind yes / tam weak / moat no / valuation yes). Conviction Low -> Low-Medium (one notch, per the small/mid-cap live-inflection rule): the Q1 FY27 inflection, completed capex, fortress balance sheet, consistent dividends and a cheap multiple justify the upgrade; ROCE ~11% / ROE ~9% well below the quality bar, a large new Rs 250 Cr greenfield (FY27-29) that will pressure returns near-term, and the unresolved Sudarshan/Heubach competitive threat cap it there.

earnings_quality.normalised_note: Margins are recovering off a low base (ROE ~9%), not at a peak. Q1 FY27's jump is early-ramp operating leverage; the risk is that Sudarshan (post-Heubach) competes pricing back down before the margin normalises higher, not that current margins are unsustainably high.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Consolidated revenue: FY24 Rs 561 Cr, FY25 Rs 695 Cr (+24%), FY26 Rs 775 Cr (+12%), Q1 FY27 run-rate ~Rs 960 Cr; consolidated PAT +~56% YoY in Q1 FY27. Trusted tracker confirms the capex ramp is on schedule.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~13.6x trailing needs only high-single-digit EPS growth; Q1 FY27 PAT +56% is far ahead, so the recent acceleration is not in the multiple - the check is whether it sustains past the commissioning quarter.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Ran the business net-cash for years with a large (Rs 376 Cr) investment book earning below operating returns - conservative to a fault, part of why ROE is ~9%. Now committing Rs 250 Cr to a greenfield plant. Consistent dividends (~22-25% payout). No unrelated diversification; adjacency moves (food/cosmetic-grade) are on-strategy.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Moving from commodity ultramarine toward specialty / food-cosmetic-grade pigment and surfactant applications

track_record.note: FY24-FY26 verifiable. Revenue growth cleared 10% in FY25 (+24%) and FY26 (+12%) but ROCE was ~10-11% in every year - well short of 15% - so no year cleared both legs. Long-listed company, so the zero is an informative record of chronically sub-bar capital returns (a large idle investment book is part of the cause), not a young-company artefact. ROCE is now improving off the completed capex; FY27 could clear if the Q1 margin holds.

four_box.note: Completed pigment/surfactant capacity plus a shift into food/cosmetic/personal-care grades is a genuine multi-year growth driver - tailwind yes; but ultramarine is a niche/mature core category and a 10x off ~Rs 1,230 Cr needs the specialty adjacencies to scale hard - tam weak; Sudarshan Chemicals' Heubach acquisition is a specific, credible competitive threat and ROCE ~11% shows no pricing power - moat no; ~13.6x P/E, ~1.4x book and ~Rs 376 Cr of investments (~30% of market cap, net cash) with PAT inflecting +56% - valuation yes. Score 2.5 -> written exception (valuation box = yes) permits the 10x-in-2-3-years label with conviction capped at Medium; set at Low-Medium given weak structural ROCE and the competitive threat.
